title: Build buy or wait - cities in game
author: New_Patience_8107
selftext:
I'm building a tactical RTS. It's not turn based but it plays out in a week before you plan again at home base. In that week your squad can go out into the city and interact with business, get into shooting battles with rival groups.

Ideally the city in with the game takes place will be procedurally generated. There will be variations of shopfronts linked to some businesses. Other variations will be ghetto areas or downtown. It's set in an American city at the turn of the 20th century.

I'm seeing some people building procedural generators. I feel like this is something that should exist but maybe its a paid plugin somewhere. I need something I can reprogram to suit the rules of the game world and that I can also offer to players looking for sandbox and modding options. Not sure if this problem has been solved or if I just wait a bit 10 open source solutions will arrive. 

Nothing to show still working on my MVP just at the early stage need to confront this. I have some assets but building my asset pipeline is another piece I am working between Meshy blender and Godot. 

Tldr - How do I build a time period city in short time and have it respond to game rules at scale?
